metadata.title: Secure Print Platform SSPP
metadata.remarks: Platform-level System Security and Privacy Plan asserting institutional trust, governance, and responsibility for Secure Print services.

import-profile.remarks: Imports the institutional security and privacy baseline. Secure Print inherits applicable controls through approved platform patterns.

system-characteristics.system-description: The Secure Print Platform provides institutionally governed, authenticated, auditable, and accountable printing services, supporting secure job submission, controlled release, output handling, retention, and evidentiary logging across managed printing infrastructure.

props.name: platform-capability
props.remarks: Secure Print is a foundational institutional platform service enabling controlled generation of physical output from digital information systems.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Printers and multifunction devices are treated as output devices requiring controlled access to prevent unauthorized disclosure of printed information.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Printed output containing CUI is classified as controlled media and must be physically protected and handled appropriately.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Printers and multifunction devices may retain copies of print jobs on internal storage and must be sanitized prior to reuse, return, or disposal.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Printing workflows fall within the scope of protecting data in use, transit, and at rest.

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Secure Print supports institutional information management by enabling controlled physical output of business information.

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Printed output may constitute official institutional records subject to retention and disposition requirements.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Secure Print is realised through document handling and rendering application services managing print job lifecycle.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Identity and access services authenticate users and authorize secure print release.

props.name: data-patttern
props.remarks: Secure Print processes digital documents as governed data assets prior to physical rendering.

props.name: data-pattern
props.remarks: Printed output and associated audit logs may become records subject to records classification and retention.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Printing and scanning technologies provide the technical foundation for Secure Print services.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Identity and authentication technologies enable secure user binding and controlled print release.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Logging and monitoring technologies support accountability, auditability, and incident response for printing activities.

props.name: mitre-attack
props.remarks: Adversaries may access sensitive information via print spooling, cached print jobs, or unsecured output trays.

props.name: mitre-attack
props.remarks: Printed output can be used as an alternative data exfiltration channel bypassing digital monitoring controls.

props.name: mitre-attack-tactic
props.remarks: Collection activities related to print job harvesting and output exposure.

props.name: mitre-attack
props.remarks: Valid credentials may be abused to authenticate to secure print release mechanisms or print management systems.

props.name: mitre-attack
props.remarks: Automated collection techniques may target queued print jobs or printer-resident storage.

props.name: mitre-d3fend
props.remarks: Strong user authentication and identity binding for print submission and secure release mitigates unauthorized access and misuse.

props.name: mitre-d3fend
props.remarks: Access control mechanisms restrict who can submit, release, and retrieve printed output.

props.name: mitre-d3fend
props.remarks: Logging of print activity supports detection, investigation, and accountability for misuse or data exposure.

props.name: mitre-d3fend
props.remarks: Monitoring of printing systems and workflows enables detection of anomalous or policy-violating behavior.

props.name: mitre-d3fend
props.remarks: Controls governing print release and output handling reduce the risk of unauthorized disclosure through printed materials.

system-implementation.remarks: Secure Print is implemented through composition of approved institutional security patterns. This SSPP introduces no standalone or compensating controls.

components.title: Secure Print (Composite Trust Assertion)
components.description: Composite architectural assertion that confidentiality, accountability, governance, and lifecycle protections for institutional printing are satisfied.

control-implementation.remarks: All applicable security and privacy controls are inherited through Secure Print platform patterns. No controls are implemented directly by this SSPP.
